messages.subject: Texas KA Interested in Energy banking @ Piper Sandler
messages.body:
Hi Joseph,

I hope you are doing well. I am a PC ‘22 KA studying Business and Economics
and am pursuing a career in Energy investment banking in Houston. I'd love
to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Piper Sandeler.

If you have any free time in the next week, I would love to set up a quick
phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to
accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be
willing to do this.

Best,

Jonathan
